title: Multi-Head Attention with Rotary Embeddings
summary: Split a model's features into heads, run attention in every head at once, and give queries and keys a sense of position by rotating them with RoPE.

ShapeMismatch.hint: Write down every intermediate shape: (B, T, D) → (B, T, H, d_head) → (B, H, T, d_head). Reshape and transpose are different operations.

NaNInSoftmax.hint: A NaN in the weights usually means a whole row was masked or the softmax overflowed. Revisit the masking and max-subtraction from the previous exercise.

hints.test_split_heads_shape_and_layout: Reshaping (B, T, D) straight to (B, H, T, d_head) scrambles tokens and features together. Reshape to (B, T, H, d_head) first, then transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).
hints.test_merge_heads_inverts_split: Undo the steps in reverse order: transpose(0, 2, 1, 3) back to (B, T, H, d_head), then reshape to (B, T, H * d_head).
hints.test_split_heads_rejects_indivisible: Check D % n_heads before reshaping and raise ValueError if it isn't 0.
hints.test_rope_frequencies_values: theta_i = base ** (-2i / d_head) for i = 0 .. d_head/2 − 1. np.arange(0, d_head, 2) / d_head gives the exponents 2i / d_head directly.
hints.test_apply_rope_matches_reference: Angles are positions[:, None] * theta[None, :], shape (T, d/2). Rotate the interleaved pairs: even' = even·cos − odd·sin, odd' = even·sin + odd·cos.
hints.test_rope_preserves_norms: A rotation never changes length. If norms change, your cos/sin terms are paired with the wrong features or have the wrong sign.
hints.test_rope_dot_product_depends_only_on_of: Rotating q by mθ and k by nθ leaves their dot product depending on (m − n)θ. Use the same frequencies and the same pairing for q and k.
hints.test_apply_rope_does_not_mutate_input: Write the rotated values into a new array (np.empty_like), not into x.
hints.test_mha_matches_reference: Project with x @ W, split heads, apply RoPE to q and k only (never v), scale by √d_head (not √D), softmax over keys, merge heads, then multiply by W_o.
hints.test_causal_mha_ignores_future_tokens: Build a (T, T) lower-triangular boolean mask and set disallowed scores to -inf before the softmax. It broadcasts across batch and heads.
